variety_description: Average yielding, medium maturity, tall, medium bold variety suitable for cultivation under rainfed lowland conditions. Pure line selection from a local variety. Developed by BRRI and released in 1998 for planting in all over Bangladesh in Aman season. Long panicle with high number of grains. Aromatic rice with good taste. Susceptible to Leaf blast
